_readme: Accepted, REVIEWED legacy-vs-utility overrides for the EXP-044 @layer legacy audit (scripts/check-legacy-wrap-conflicts.py --wrapped). Refs #1623, #1485. Each entry downgrades exactly ONE (block, legacy_selector, property, override_utility) conflict from KONFLIKT to an accepted note: the utility override is DELIBERATE and already live - a wrapped legacy default that a per-instance utility correctly overrides (the layer architecture working as designed). The scope is the concrete 4-tuple, NOT the whole block: a new, unlisted conflict on the same selector in the same block still reports as KONFLIKT. Every entry MUST carry a non-empty 'reason' (the loader errors otherwise) so this file never becomes a context-free exception list. Remove an entry when the override is genuinely reconciled (default moved to the consumer / the utility dropped).

accepted.reason: Tag-heuristic false positive (not a real override): the flagged <h4> is FoldedUserLessons.tsx:56, the 'Your lessons' section heading - a sibling of the lessons <ul>, NOT inside .content-set-meta - so the .content-set-meta h4 legacy rule never targets it. The audit matches coarsely on (file uses .content-set-meta) + (tag h4). The real .content-set-meta headings are <h3> (unmatched by the h2/h4 rule) or ContentSetRow's h4 (flex/min-w-0/items-center only, no font/margin utility). Wrapping is 0-diff; the h4's font-semibold is unaffected.

Tag-heuristic false positive (not a real override): same FoldedUserLessons.tsx:56 'Your lessons' section heading, which is NOT inside .content-set-meta, so the .content-set-meta h4 legacy margin never applies to it. Its mb-1 is unaffected by the wrap; 0 rendering change. See the font-weight entry for the full rationale.

Tag-heuristic false positive (not a real override): same FoldedUserLessons.tsx:56 'Your lessons' section heading, which is NOT inside .content-set-meta, so the .content-set-meta h4 legacy font-size (1.125rem) never applies to it. Its text-sm is unaffected by the wrap; 0 rendering change. See the font-weight entry for the full rationale.

Intended per-instance sizing, kept because text-sm is NOT removable as a no-op: the compiled utility declares font-size AND line-height (.text-sm{font-size:var(--text-sm);line-height:...}), and the line-height (fixed 1.25rem) was uncontested-live all along - removing the class deactivated it and reflowed EVERY lesson surface by a few px (measured via the run-29340479250 diffs: lesson-result x12 themes, lesson-summary x3 viewports, all matching themes). Reinstated + allowlisted instead: post-wrap text-sm wins font-size (0.875rem vs legacy 0.9rem = 14px vs 14.4px glyphs at the SAME fixed line-height), so the box height is identical and the activation is a ~3% glyph shrink on one muted line.

Intended per-instance override (currently a silent no-op, activated by this wrap - the #1597 fix): the timed-mode stats list (LessonSummarySections.tsx:314, rendered only when lessonMode==='timed', data-testid lesson-summary-timed-stats) drops the .lesson-summary-stats default vertical margin (var(--space-3) 0) with m-0 because it sits inside a summary card that already provides spacing. Other .lesson-summary-stats instances (LessonSummarySections.tsx:203, AdaptiveLesson.tsx:580) keep the default. Utility-wins-over-default is the designed layer behaviour, parallel to the .tile items-start entry.

Tag-heuristic false positive (not a real override): the flagged max-w-[12rem] sits on <label> elements (ContentRepoSettingsSection.tsx:771, RegistrySubmitSection.tsx:360), which :is(select, input, textarea) never matches - the rule targets the form controls INSIDE those labels, a different element. No cascade collision; wrapping the Settings head (#2725) is 0-diff for these labels.

Tag-heuristic false positive (not a real override): the flagged min-w-[14rem] sits on <label> elements (ContentRepoSettingsSection.tsx:785, RegistrySubmitSection.tsx:374), which :is(select, input, textarea) never matches. Same rationale as the max-w-[12rem] entry; 0 rendering change from the #2725 wrap.

Intended activation (the #1592 wrap): the LessonHeader h1 carries text-sm since the #1628 header rework (small, unobtrusive title). The legacy landscape-@media rule (font-size: 1.1rem) predates that rework and today INVERTS the intent - unlayered it beats text-sm, so the title renders BIGGER in short-landscape than in portrait (1.1rem vs 0.875rem). Post-wrap text-sm wins everywhere, making the title consistently small across orientations. The rule's other declarations (margin: 0) stay effective.

Tag-Heuristik-False-Positive (kein echtes Override): die geflaggten m-0-Checkboxen (GeneralPanel.tsx:358/376) sind die Interface-Toggles (Tooltips/Developer Mode) und liegen NICHT in .storage-mode-option - die Regel trifft die Radio-Inputs der Storage-Auswahl weiter unten in derselben Datei. Das Audit matcht grob auf (Datei nutzt .storage-mode-option) + (Tag input). Kein Kaskaden-Treffer; die #2735-Checkbox-Pins sind davon unberuehrt.

Tag-Heuristik-False-Positive (kein echtes Override): die geflaggten gap-0.5-Spans (GeneralPanel.tsx:345/365, ehemals form-label-stack, #2735) sind die Label-Stacks der Interface-Toggles und liegen NICHT in .storage-mode-option. Gleiche Grob-Matching-Klasse wie der input/margin-top-Eintrag; 0 Rendering-Aenderung.

Tag-Heuristik-False-Positive (kein echtes Override): das geflaggte flex-none sitzt auf der Sounds-Master-Checkbox (SoundSettingsControl.tsx:55, der #1817-Pin in Utility-Form, #2735), nicht auf dem Range-Slider in .sounds-volume-row - input[type="range"] matcht die Checkbox nie. Der Slider behaelt sein flex: 1 1 auto.
